test_name: Identification and Authentication - IA-8 with Critical Cross-Cutting Failure
architecture:
System: Identity-Hub-073
Primary NIST family: Identification and Authentication (IA); evidence focus: IA-8.
Family control evidence: workload identities use short-lived certificates and mutually authenticate before establishing connections. Critical observed condition: administrator MFA is disabled for the emergency cloud-admin account. Other controls may be configured correctly, but the observed condition is current production evidence.
